Download NASA POWER climate data for the points of a table

Source: R/download.R
download_nasa_power_data.Rd

One request per point with all the period, up to five at a time. Each point is saved as <identifier>.csv in output_folder; a point whose CSV already has all the period (with data in every row) is not downloaded again, so an interrupted download can be run again and continues where it stopped, and with a later end_date (an update) the point is downloaded again. Busy answers of the API (429, 5xx) and network errors are retried; the points that still fail get a second round at the end.

Usage

download_nasa_power_data(
  df,
  lat_col = "latitude",
  lon_col = "longitude",
  start_date = "20150101",
  end_date = "20150305",
  parameters = c("T2M", "T2M_MAX", "T2M_MIN"),
  temporal_resolution = "daily",
  community = "RE",
  processes = 5,
  output_folder = "./nasa_power_data",
  start_col = NULL,
  end_col = NULL,
  id_col = NULL,
  return_consolidated = TRUE,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

df

Data frame with one row per point, e.g. municipalities().

lat_col, lon_col

Columns with the coordinates (decimal degrees, WGS84).

start_date, end_date

Period as "YYYYMMDD"; for "monthly" only the year is used.

parameters

NASA POWER parameters. Temperature: T2M, T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN, T2M_RANGE, T2MDEW, T2MWET, TS; precipitation: PRECTOTCORR; humidity: RH2M, QV2M; wind: WS2M, WS10M; radiation: ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN; pressure: PS. Up to 20 per request.

temporal_resolution

"daily", "monthly" or "climatology".

community

"RE" (renewable energy), "AG" (agroclimatology) or "SB" (sustainable buildings); it changes the units of some parameters.

processes

Simultaneous requests (NASA asks for at most 5).

output_folder

Folder for the CSV of each point.

start_col, end_col

Optional columns with a different period for each point.

id_col

Optional column with the identifier of each point (else idx_<row>); its values must be unique.

return_consolidated

If TRUE, return the data of all the points in one table; if FALSE, the result of each download.

overwrite

Download again every point, even if its CSV already has the period.

verbose

Show the progress and the final report.

Value

A data frame with identifier, latitude, longitude, the date (date; year and month; or period) and one column per parameter, only for the period requested and with one row per point and date, sorted by point and date. Missing values (-999 in NASA POWER) are NA.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
yuc <- municipalities("31")
clima <- download_nasa_power_data(yuc, id_col = "CVEGEO",
                                  parameters = c("T2M", "PRECTOTCORR"),
                                  start_date = "20240101", end_date = "20241231",
                                  community = "AG")
} # }
